text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Zine al-Abidine Ben Ali holds meeting with visiting Qatar Emir Sheikh Hamad bin Khalifa al-Thani on bilateral cooperation in industry and investment.
- Tunisian-Qatar joint business council focuses on need to promote trade exchanges and reinforce economic cooperation.
- The Tunisian Agency for the Promotion of Industry (API) says investment projects rose by 31.4 percent in the first four months of 1997 compared with the same period of 1996.
- Tunisia signs a loan accord with the Japanese Eximbank amounting to 10-billion yen to finance private sector.
- Tunisia elects members of Africain Commission of Human rights.
- The Meditteranean environment forum to be held in Tunis next year.
- Industry Minister Slaheddine Bouguerra asked the Agency for the Promotion of Industry to better inform firms.
